intro: Unbeatable Fire-Resistance for Your Documents - Tested and Certified at international laboratories

features.title: Digital Locking Mechanism
features.text: The lock allows secure access with a customizable 4-8 digit password, giving you flexibility and security tailored to your preference. The system's non-volatile memory ensures reliable password storage, even during power outages.

features.title: 3-Way Live Shooting Bolt
features.text: Equipped with an advanced 3-Way Live Shooting Bolt system, this powerful mechanism features 4 front, 1 top, and 1 bottom live bolts, ensuring comprehensive security. Additionally, the safe is reinforced with 2 rear fixed bolts, adding an extra layer of defense against unauthorized access, keeping your most precious belongings safe and secure.

features.title: Fire Resistant Safe Certified by ECB-S
features.text: Certified by ECB-S certification body, our locker provides a minimum of 90 minutes of fire resistance. This ensures that your documents are safeguarded against fire damage while adhering to the highest safety standards.

features.title: Double Walled Body & Door
features.text: Our locker is designed with a durable, fire-resistant double-walled body and door, filled with specialized fire-resistant material. This advanced construction significantly slows down heat transfer, ensuring maximum protection for your documents and keeping them safe and secure in the event of a fire.

features.title: Built-in Buzz Alarm: Enhanced Security for Your Home Locker
features.text: Our locker features a built-in buzz alarm that adds an extra layer of protection for your documents. If anyone attempts to tamper with or force open the locker, the alarm will activate, instantly alerting you to potential unauthorized access.

features.title: Tongue & Groove Construction
features.text: Equipped with advanced tongue and groove construction that enhances security and provides superior fire resistance. This design ensures tight seals and improved structural integrity, effectively protecting your documents from fire by preventing hot gases and smoke from seeping inside.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. It is Recommended to anchor the Locker with bolts from the bottom as well as the back into a cupboard or onto the wall.
